project.description:
DWM — the UI subsystem, codenamed after Windows' Desktop Window Manager (the NT/hardware metaphor the project already uses: core=NT kernel, board=PCB, compat=AppCompat). A detachable AUXILIARY layer, NOT a skeleton module: it holds no security-decision power, imports no core class, and is discovered/loaded by Board via the reflective Backplane (same idiom Board uses to find mcp-core). Delete dwm and everything still compiles.
Architecture (see .ai-notes/design-briefs/dwm-material-design.md): UI is written against DWM's own layers ONLY (component API + theme). The render backend (imgui first) sits behind the RenderBackend/DrawContext SPI and is hot-swappable — swapping the backend changes nothing above the SPI line. imgui / OpenGL types appear in exactly ONE backend-adapter package and nowhere else. This skeleton defines the SPI + compositor + component base; the imgui backend adapter and the MDC-parity component set land on top of these interfaces.
